answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 569 Country: NL Title: How should I pray Isha in Helsinki, Finland, where the night is very short, and can I combine Maghrib and Isha? Question: Assalamualaikum, I am in Helsinki, Finland at present, here I am unable to pray namaz on timing as here day timings is different. Here sunset is at 9:30pm so magribh will be at same time. also i have gone thorugh some sites where i found namaz timing which says that isha is not there. you can find that at islamicacdemy.org, as far as now i am combining magrib and isha prayers, can you please suggest me what to do in this case. Allah hafez. Answer ID: 569 Posted on: Feb 26, 2025 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 758=531/H) It is obvious that the time of Maghrib Salah will start from sunset. Similarly, the time of Fajr Salah is before sunrise. Between these times you should offer Isha Salah there (in Finland). This is the fatwa of Ulama that though Isha time is not clear at such places but it must be performed. (Nizamul Fatwa, V 1, P 58, Islamic Fiqh Academy, Dlehi) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
